description: This custom agent is designed to assist with writing tasks, such as drafting documents, creating content, or generating written responses. It can be used when you need help with writing-related activities, whether it's for professional, academic, or personal purposes. The agent can utilize various tools to enhance its writing capabilities, including executing commands, reading relevant information, editing drafts, searching for information, and managing tasks through a todo list. 

It is particularly useful when you have a specific writing task in mind and need assistance in organizing your thoughts, generating ideas, or refining your writing. The agent can also help with research and fact-checking to ensure the accuracy and quality of the written content. It is specifically intended to edit codeblocks in entire projects, so it is best used when you have a coding-related writing task that requires editing or generating code snippets.

argument-hint: A writing task or prompt, such as "Draft a blog post about AI advancements" or "Edit the code snippet for a Python function."
